{{Top|leg}}
The '''Droid motion sensors Type 1''' were devices that enabled a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] to better detect organics hidden by [[Stealth field generator/Legends|stealth fields]]. This basic model was the most inexpensive version and was commonly available on many [[Planet/Legends|worlds]]. It was installed in the wreckage of a [[Rakatan guardian droid]] in the [[Rakatan ruins (Dantooine)|Rakatan ruins]] on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]].

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 1 to be able to equip this item.
